article_title: Meet the pensioners spending the kids' inheritance

tasks.prompt: What broader change does the article explore through the retirees it profiles?
options: Some retirees are prioritising experiences over leaving an inheritance, while financial security remains unequal
All pensioners now spend their entire pension on travel
Adult children are legally entitled to inherit their parents' savings
Final-salary pensions have become more common
tasks.correct_answer: Some retirees are prioritising experiences over leaving an inheritance, while financial security remains unequal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת מגמה שבה חלק מהגמלאים מעדיפים חוויות על פני הורשה, אך מדגישה שהמצב הכלכלי של גמלאים אינו אחיד.

tasks.prompt: What does the term “skiing” stand for in the article?
options: Saving knowledge in independent investment groups
Spending the kids' inheritance
Securing kids' income in government funds
Sharing known investments internationally
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המונח הוא ראשי תיבות של spending the kids' inheritance ומתאר הוצאת הכסף במקום השארתו ליורשים.

tasks.prompt: What does “at the drop of a hat” mean in Sarah Moorhouse's description of retirement?
options: Only after selling a valuable object
At the end of every financial year
Immediately or with very little planning
After receiving permission from her daughters
tasks.correct_answer: Immediately or with very little planning
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר עשייה מיידית או ספונטנית, כמעט ללא תכנון מוקדם.

tasks.prompt: What does “tops up her private pension” mean in Karen Green's case?
options: She transfers all pension money to her children
She stops receiving income from property
She converts her pension into a final-salary scheme
She adds to her pension income through consultancy work
tasks.correct_answer: She adds to her pension income through consultancy work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: top up פירושו להשלים או להוסיף; קארן מוסיפה להכנסת הפנסיה באמצעות עבודת ייעוץ.

tasks.prompt: What change does Mike Ambery link to the growth of “skiing” in the UK?
options: The decline of guaranteed final-salary pensions and growth of pension pots that can run out
A legal ban on leaving money to adult children
A sharp fall in the UK state pension age
A rule requiring retirees to travel abroad
tasks.correct_answer: The decline of guaranteed final-salary pensions and growth of pension pots that can run out
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אמברי קושר את המגמה להיעלמות פנסיות שכר־סופי מובטחות ולמעבר לקופות שעלולות להתרוקן.

tasks.prompt: What does “legacy” mean when Karen tells her children there is unlikely to be one?
options: Her remaining consultancy contract
Money or assets left to others after death
A discount she finds for a holiday
The annual state pension payment
tasks.correct_answer: Money or assets left to others after death
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר הזה legacy היא ירושה: כסף או נכסים שנותרים לאחר המוות.

tasks.prompt: Give two details showing how Karen Green finances her lifestyle before receiving the UK state pension.
expected_points: She continues part-time business consultancy work
She draws on a private pension
She receives 40% of her funds from renting out a property
She says her monthly income matches what she earned in full-time work
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מקורות או פרטי הכנסה מן הכתבה, בלי להסיק שהיא מייצגת את כל הגמלאים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article say open communication between retirees and adult children matters?
expected_points: Some adult children may expect or plan to rely on an inheritance
Retirees may instead intend to spend most of their assets
Sarah's daughter accepts her parents' choice and Karen has warned her children
Clear expectations can reduce later misunderstanding about a legacy
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את פער הציפיות האפשרי ולהסתמך על הדוגמאות או דברי המומחה, בלי לקבוע שילדים זכאים לירושה.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the “skiing” trend, the reasons offered for it and the limits of treating it as universal.
expected_points: Some retirees choose travel and enjoyment over preserving an inheritance
Fifteen percent of UK parents surveyed planned to prioritise retirement enjoyment
The decline of guaranteed final-salary pensions changes attitudes to legacies
Examples include Sarah and Geoff Moorhouse and Karen Green
Many pensioners are not wealthy, with poverty figures given for both the UK and US
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום באנגלית המשלב דוגמאות, נתונים והסתייגות מאי־השוויון; אין להציג את המגמה כבחירה של כל הגמלאים.

tasks.prompt: Using the article, discuss whether spending retirement savings on experiences can be considered responsible.
expected_points: Sarah and Karen value enjoyment after years of work
Their adult children have been told about or support the decision
Defined-contribution pension pots can run out, creating longevity risk
Both profiled households have multiple income or asset sources
The article notes substantial pensioner poverty and warns against generalising
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב טיעון מאוזן באנגלית עם ראיות בעד החופש ליהנות מהכסף ועם שיקולים של ביטחון כלכלי, תקשורת משפחתית ואי־שוויון.
